description:
Emergent Threats/IX Revival: Download Version 1.3.3
Compatible with v1.1+ Github link with patch notes.

This Remnant focused mod seeks to make the faction a true challenge for the late game, while offering the player a chance to try out unique technologies on captured and modified drone ships. The mod also adds new content for the Sindrian Diktat, Tri-Tachyon, Persean League, Independents, and new missions with unique rewards to challenge the player.

Fights against the Remnant may become extremely hard, especially if you do not have many other Remnant related mods installed. Pick your battles carefully. If you find the battles too difficult, you can make adjustments in LunaLib settings. Cross-mod content for Second In Command, Hazard Mining Incorporated, and Random Assortment of Things can also be toggled there.

Emergent Threats: IX Revival
The mod .zip file comes bundled with the 9th Domain Battlegroup standalone mod. This antagonist faction was first created in the now abandoned Arsenal Expansion mod by Inventor Raccoon, and has been revived with permission. Both ET mods can be used independently, but will interact with each other with extra content. Note that if you are running a bootleg version of Arsenal Expansion, you should disable the original's battlegroup in its mod settings to avoid two versions of the faction spawning at the same time.

Changelog

Spoiler
v1.3.3 should be compatible with v1.1+

Emergent Threats
Misc
-(IX Revival) updated the adaptive subsystem enemy encounter logic so ships equipped with Dawnstar beam weapons that already deal hard flux are less likely to receive adaptive emitter diodes

IX Revival
Misc
-Updated the art for docking at Vertex Station and the warning for trading forbidden AI tech to Tri-Tachyon to be more in line with the game art style
-Updated docking text for Vertex Station

Ships
-Astral (TW) port/starboard medium energy weapon firing arcs increased from 200 to 220 degrees to lower occurrence of broadsiding

Weapons
-Brightburn CIWS (normal/ER built-in) updated to a rotary cannon that fires all pulses out of the same location rather than be spread out over three barrels, improving missile intercept chances
-Morningstar/Lightbringer CIWS get a new firing sound, Brightburn CIWS gets its own unique sound

v1.3.2 should be compatible with v1.1+ although not guaranteed

Emergent Threats
Misc
-(SIC) Synthesis XO capstone skill Temporal Accelerator will now increase all weapon rate of fire by 10% without increasing flux cost
-(SIC/PAGSM) added icon graphics overwrite in the main mod folder to make Andradanism more awesome, see turbocharge_andradanism_for_pagsm folder readme
-(NEX) Changed Tri-Tachyon Mutilator supership start to include a Revenant instead of a Buffalo (TT)
-Fixed a bug where applying Interdictor Array hullmod to one Paragon in ET would make all Paragons change ship systems
-Fixed a bug with the Political Officer hullmod that caused crashes in cross-mod and codex browsing

Fighters
-Starquake heavy drone role updated to Support, role description updated to Drone Gunship

Ships
-Aquilon, Candor, Glycon, Maquech, Odyssey (TT), Stonefish added to high tech blueprint package, and will also show up as historian blueprints
-Flamebreaker (EX) deployment points reduced from 30 to 25
-Iris (EX) destroyer that was accidentally removed from the game is re-added to Experimental Design Blueprint package, markets, and fleet spawns
-Maquech carrier ship system PD Drones replaced with Targeting Sweep, a weaker version of Targeting Feed
-Proteus carrier Rapid Deployment will replenish fighters of 12 OP or less, instead of 10

Ship Systems
-Targeting Sweep damage increased from 25% to 30%, added text showing this bonus in codex

Hullmods
-Adaptive Flight Command can now be combined with Converted Shuttles (Attack), Converted Shuttles (Bomber), and Carrier Gunships without additional penalty
-(IX) Unified Targeting Core can now be found on IX and Trinity Worlds markets if both ET and IX are installed, and will be used by certain IX/TW NPC ships
-(SIC) Political Officer hullmod should no longer drop, as it is automatically unlocked upon activating an Andradanism XO

IX Revival
Misc
-Antimatter Stabilizer cost increased from 10,000 to 100,000 credits
-Trinity Worlds will use carriers slightly more often
-(NEX) Added Trinity Worlds Conflux (TW) supership start
-Fixed a bug where the Aurora (TW) would not use its undershield in player hands
-Hopefully fixed a bug to make the Aurora (TW) "sensor shadow" wreck found during the Lure Infected Fleet mission encounter not recoverable
-Fixed a rare crossmod bug that causes station encounters to crash when the station fleet does not have a flagship
-(AotD) Fixed a bug with the game crashing on the new AotD industry preview window when examining Marzanna Cartel HQ

Fighters
-Minor updates to IX fighter sprites
-Starquake (TW) role updated to Support, role description updated to Drone Gunship, Stormwall Salvo range increased from 1100 to 1500
-Ultimatum (IX) Temporal Gunship added to the Equalizer (IX) and Mokosh (IX), enabled via the Carrier Gunships hullmod

Ships
-Aurora (TW) sprite slightly updated
-Astral (TW) added as a rare spawn for Trinity Worlds fleets, comes with unique hullmods, new weapons layout, and built-in variant of the Apotheosis drone, and can switch ship systems and combat behavior with Carrier Gunships
-Conflux (TW) added, for now can only be obtained through Trinity Worlds supership start in Nexerelin
-Flamebreaker (IX/TW) deployment points reduced from 30 to 25
-Flourish (TW) sprite slightly updated
-Fury (TW) added, comes with its own undershield even though it is still very fragile
-Hetman (A) ship system PD Drones replaced with Targeting Sweep, +30% damage to deployed fighters for a short time
-(PAGSM) Iapetus (TW) updated
-Ionos (TW) purchase cost lowered slightly
-Maquech (TW) ship system PD Drones replaced with Targeting Sweep, +30% damage to deployed fighters for a short time
-Mokosh (IX) carrier added, an Anubis derived carrier with Immanence Engine ship system
-Fleet Point reduction for various IX capital ships (Aquilon 28 to 26, Odyssey 30 to 28, Equalizer/Intrepid/Paragon from 35 to 32), slightly reducing their effectiveness in NPC on NPC fights on the campaign layer
-Undershield modules on ships gain passive venting (100/s for Flourish, 150/s for Fury, 200/s for Aurora), and can vent 15% of this as hard flux, allowing undershields to passively recharge even when not actively venting, preventing undershields from being indefinitely partially used up after a skirmish even when there are no enemies nearby

Ship System
-Immanence Engine ship system on carriers now also applies its effect to deployed Ultimatum (IX) Temporal Gunships, Immanence Engine cooldown reduced from 20 seconds to 15 seconds, Scarab (IX) version remains at 10 second cooldown

Weapons
-Charge Transfer Emitter seeker projectile initial launch velocity lowered from 800 to 300 to lower occurrences of overshooting the target, EMP effect will trigger at 1600 su with Converging Seeker Lens hullmod
-Dawnstar/Daythron emitter Neutron Generator extra shield damage per second lowered from 150/100/50 kinetic to 90/60/30 kinetic
-Dawnstar/Daythron emitter Proton Generator effect changed from 60/40/20 armor removed per second to 360/240/120 extra fragmentation damage per second on hitting armor/hull
-Impact Fusion Cannon turn rate increase from 12 to 15, gains a magazine that will increase its DPS from 200 (+100 on impact) to 300 (+150) while ammo lasts
-Morningstar CIWS (Fighter) range increased from 500 to 700, found on Terminus (IX) and Ultimatum (IX) wings
-Muon Autolance description update to remove reference to the streamer variant which no longer exists
-Starfall MLRS/Rocket Pod minimal flux cost removed, descriptions updated
-Thundermark Ion Seeker projectile hitpoints lowered from 200 to 50, EMP effect is now against hull/armor only by default, with shield piercing needing Converging Seeker Lens hullmod
-Vampyr DEM graphics reverted from traveling to instant EMP bolts

Hullmods
-Activate Starquake Drones updated and renamed to Carrier Gunships, and can now also be used on the Astral (TW), Equalizer (IX), and Mokosh (IX) in addition to the Radiant (TW), will add Ultimatum (IX) Gunships on the IX carriers, and can be combined with the Adaptive Flight Command hullmod, and on non-player ships only, if ET is installed, will also convert not built-in Dedicated Targeting Core/Integrated Targeting Unit to Unified Targeting Core on the carrier
-Converging Seeker Lens added to IX/TW markets and NPC ship variants, improves range (and sometimes performance) of Seeker type energy weapons
-Drone Control Node for Trinity Worlds ships is made known to the player at the start of the game
-Energy Weapon Overcharger (obtained from installing an Antimatter Stabilizer to a ship) bonus changed from 25% energy weapon rate of fire and flux cost and 30% range penalty to 35% energy weapon rate of fire bonus, 25% extra energy weapon flux cost (a ~7.4% flux efficiency bonus when ROF is taken into account), and a 20% range penalty
-Entropy Arrester hullmod renamed to Immanence Engine to match ship system
-Trinity Worlds Retrofit default hullmod on TW ships now also applies previously missing 10% range penalty to missile and archaic composite weapons

Note to translator: the exact changes are included in the github notes

IX Battlegroup Preview

Spoiler

Remnant Ship Preview

Spoiler

Lampetia Drone Mothership
Fast moving battlecarrier derived from the militarized Odyssey (TT)

Incandescent Drone Battleship
Aggressive battleship armed with dual Hydromagnetic Cannons that degrade enemy ship performance

Resplendent Command Droneship
Heavy carrier capable of mass deploying a swarm of drones, or enhancing a smaller number of bombers

Jubilant Missile Droneship
A light missile cruiser that packs a heavy opening punch

Effulgent Droneship
A missile variant of the Fulgent for supporting Remnant fleets at range

Candor (EMP) Gunship
A deadly frigate that can fire its EMP emitter and other weapons at the same time

Helia Strategic Bomber
Reaper torpedo bomber, with the firepower of the Cobra but twice the numbers

Sundog Defender
Mobile artillery that stays with the mothership while also providing point defense

Bolide Hunter-Killer
A new threat encountered at Nexus stations.

Faction Ship Preview

Spoiler
Experimental Hulls

Prototype High Tech designs recovered by Tri-Tachyon, with rarely seen experimental ship systems.

Odyssey (TT) Battlecarrier
Fast and versatile carrier based on the Odyssey and perfected by Tri-Tachyon

Aquilon Battlecruiser
Variable munitions battlecruiser with a ship system suited to every situation

Glycon Missile Cruiser
A high-tech cruiser with staying power that uses small missiles to devastating effect

Maquech Escort Carrier
A Buffalo carrier conversion for those who can't afford better

Candor Gunship
A nimble skirmisher with built-in light ion cannons

Hellfire Colossus Battlecruiser
If it works but it gets you killed, your pirate friends will be very glad it works

Banteng Long-haul Freighter
A versatile long range freighter designed to haul both fuel and cargo at the same time

Proteus Carrier
Despite the carrier's paint job, the League has turned a lemon into lemonade

Exhortation Battlecarrier
Of course the fleet carrier for the Diktat would be fearsome and glorious!

Unifier Flight Deck Cruiser
A carrier-cruiser hybrid that went into production due to a word from the Supreme Executor

Preceptor Escort Carrier
A converted freighter since relegated to the Diktat Navy

Kite (LG) Gunship
The humble shuttle converted into a carrier based gunship

Estoc Bomber
A DEM torpedo with a biological guidance system

Spatha Heavy Fighter
The Diktat's latest standard heavy fighter, capable yet extremely overbuilt

Gladius (LG) Heavy Fighter
An experimental fighter reserved for the Lion's Guard

Mission Bounties

Spoiler

Resplendent (EX) Command Carrier
A relic of the last war.

Mutilator Phase Destroyer
A harbinger of the next war.

Mimesis Modified Superfreighter
An insatiable avatar of greed.

Praxis Modified Cruiser
A deadly skirmisher.

Invictus (LG) Dreadnought
A reborn titan controlled by a madman.

Onslaught (LG) Battleship
A sentimental relic.

Weapon Preview

Spoiler

Deadeye Plasma Seeker
A heavy energy weapon that can track its target.

Atropos MIRV
A long range strike weapon with plentiful ammo.

X-Ray Pulse Laser
Extended range pulse laser, a reliable workhorse among large energy weapons.

Kinetic Blaster (modded)
Ersatz [SUPER ALABASTER] pulse weapon with high anti-shield burst damage but extreme weakness against armor.

Siege Burst Laser
A Diktat (re)invention, bulky and power hungry, but effective against both shields and armor.

Tactical Burst Laser
A smaller Siege Burst Laser that works on a similar principle.

Ion Streamer
An ultralight EMP beam weapon.

Stinger Catapult
A point defense mine launcher.

Hullmod Preview

Spoiler

Adaptive Subsystems
Unique one-per-ship Remnant hullmods that enhance ship performance, often in unusual ways.
They are dynamically added to all Remnant ships encountered by the player, even those from other mods.

Also includes new Emergent Technologies hullmods that will modify your ships in unique and interesting ways.

Many more existing variants of Remnant ships have been refit, making them much more challenging in fleet battles. Revisions have also been made to Sindrian Diktat and Tri-Tachyon doctrine, making Lion's Guard ships more commonplace and available on the market, and Tri-Tachyon carriers more prevalent.

In addition, face off against unique enemies in new missions picked up from the unsanctioned bounty board, each with unique rewards (available at level 8+, aside from Faith and Fury and Project Mayfly which require level 12+):

To Hunt a White Whale: Face off against a pirate queen for a chance to gain a set of unique blueprints.
High and Mighty: Crash a black market arms deal between a smuggler and the Diktat Navy.
Shattered Fortress: Preserve the peace by striking against a Lion's Guard secret weapon.
Gaining Vantage: Track down a mysterious ghost ship and learn its secrets.
A Diamond in the Dark: Begin the hunt for the dark mover at the center of the enemies you have faced.
Faith and Fury: Intercept a mixed Pirate and Pather fleet led by a charismatic warlord who has found religion.
Project Mayfly (requires failing Faith and Fury): Put a halt to a dangerous secret project in the Persean League.
Cleaning up a Mess (requires HMI): Chase down rumors of a gate activation and face off against an unusual enemy.
A Theory of Mind (requires IX Revival): Investigate a strange meeting between numerous AI drones.

Other Features and Changes

A new threat encountered in the Circumfix system.
Swap the built-in weapons on numerous Onslaught variants (formerly Onslaught Radical Rearming).
Adds Adaptive Subsystem hullmod support for various mods with Remnant content.
(IX Revival) two new factions, the IX Battlegroup and their allies the Trinity Worlds with their own ships and weapons.
(Second In Command) Two new aptitudes, Andradanism for the Sindrian Diktat and Synthesis for the IX Battlegroup.
(Nexerelin) New Large Carrier game starts for the Proteus and Exhortation.
New hullmods for Hazard Mining Incorporated, Random Assortment of Things, Underworld.
Disables Expanded Deck Crew, Rescue Shuttle on automated ships.
Changes to the performance of Lux and Flash fighter drones (can be undone).
New sound for the Autopulse Laser (can be undone).

Future Plans

Add new content for the Diamond Nexus, allowing players to fight spawned Remnant fleets while still supporting Midnight Dissonant at Prism.

Art/Music Credit

Spoiler

HELMUT: Estoc, Spatha, Sundog, Bolide, Glycon, Maquech, Onslaught (LG), Incandescent, Hydromagnetic Cannon, X-Ray Pulse Laser, LR Burst Laser, Siege Burst Laser, Deadeye Plasma Seeker, Ion Streamer, Electrostatic Projector, Lightbringer CIWS, Twin Tactical Laser, Soliton Burst Emitter, Antecedent Device, Vampyr DEM
Snrasha, Tartiflette, tenoki: Resplendent
Tartiflette: Starquake/Starquake (TW)/Ultimatum (IX), Stonefish/Stonefish (TW)

With further edits by me. Various ship stats are also based on those found in High Tech Expansion by theDragn.

A big thank you to everyone whose freely shared ship and weapon sprites went into make this mod. Without you providing the foundations, none of this would have been possible.

Siege Burst Laser
A Diktat (re)invention, bulky and power hungry, but effective against both shields and armor.


Tactical Burst Laser
A smaller Siege Burst Laser that works on a similar principle.


Ion Streamer
An ultralight EMP beam weapon.


Stinger Catapult
A point defense mine launcher.

Hullmod Preview
Spoiler
Adaptive Subsystems
Unique one-per-ship Remnant hullmods that enhance ship performance, often in unusual ways.
They are dynamically added to all Remnant ships encountered by the player, even those from other mods.

Also includes new Emergent Technologies hullmods that will modify your ships in unique and interesting ways.

Many more existing variants of Remnant ships have been refit, making them much more challenging in fleet battles. Revisions have also been made to Sindrian Diktat and Tri-Tachyon doctrine, making Lion's Guard ships more commonplace and available on the market, and Tri-Tachyon carriers more prevalent.

In addition, face off against unique enemies in new missions picked up from the unsanctioned bounty board, each with unique rewards (available at level 8+, aside from Faith and Fury and Project Mayfly which require level 12+):
  • To Hunt a White Whale: Face off against a pirate queen for a chance to gain a set of unique blueprints.
  • High and Mighty: Crash a black market arms deal between a smuggler and the Diktat Navy.
  • Shattered Fortress: Preserve the peace by striking against a Lion's Guard secret weapon.
  • Gaining Vantage: Track down a mysterious ghost ship and learn its secrets.
  • A Diamond in the Dark: Begin the hunt for the dark mover at the center of the enemies you have faced.
  • Faith and Fury: Intercept a mixed Pirate and Pather fleet led by a charismatic warlord who has found religion.
  • Project Mayfly (requires failing Faith and Fury): Put a halt to a dangerous secret project in the Persean League.
  • Cleaning up a Mess (requires HMI): Chase down rumors of a gate activation and face off against an unusual enemy.
  • A Theory of Mind (requires IX Revival): Investigate a strange meeting between numerous AI drones.

Other Features and Changes
  • A new threat encountered in the Circumfix system.
  • Swap the built-in weapons on numerous Onslaught variants (formerly Onslaught Radical Rearming).
  • Adds Adaptive Subsystem hullmod support for various mods with Remnant content.
  • (IX Revival) two new factions, the IX Battlegroup and their allies the Trinity Worlds with their own ships and weapons.
  • (Second In Command) Two new aptitudes, Andradanism for the Sindrian Diktat and Synthesis for the IX Battlegroup.
  • (Nexerelin) New Large Carrier game starts for the Proteus and Exhortation.
  • New hullmods for Hazard Mining Incorporated, Random Assortment of Things, Underworld.
  • Disables Expanded Deck Crew, Rescue Shuttle on automated ships.
  • Changes to the performance of Lux and Flash fighter drones (can be undone).
  • New sound for the Autopulse Laser (can be undone).

Future Plans
  • Add new content for the Diamond Nexus, allowing players to fight spawned Remnant fleets while still supporting Midnight Dissonant at Prism.

discordPostHtml:
A mod for Starsector that makes the Remnant and Sindrian Diktat more challenging to fight. Also adds new ships, boss bounties, weapons, hullmods, and the IX Battlegroup hostile faction.

The mod is split into two parts, the core Emergent Threats, and the ET: IX Revival faction submod (the 9th Domain Battlegroup was originally created by Inventor Raccoon for Arsenal Expansion, and is re-added with permission). The two parts interact with each other but can be used separately.

v1.3.3 github direct link: https://github.com/vice-grip/starsector-mod-emergent-threats/releases/download/v1.3.3/EmergentThreats_v1.3.3.zip
v1.3.3 forum page: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=27284
aiDescription: Adds new Remnant factions, ships, weapons, and missions to challenge the late game. Includes the IX Battlegroup and Trinity Worlds factions with unique drone ships and technologies. Adds new content for Sindrian Diktat, Tri-Tachyon, and Persean League, along with unique bounty missions and adaptive subsystem hullmods.

changelog.1.3.3:
v1.3.3 should be compatible with v1.1+

 Emergent Threats
 Misc
-(IX Revival) updated the adaptive subsystem enemy encounter logic so ships equipped with Dawnstar beam weapons that already deal hard flux are less likely to receive adaptive emitter diodes

 IX Revival
 Misc
-Updated the art for docking at Vertex Station and the warning for trading forbidden AI tech to Tri-Tachyon to be more in line with the game art style
-Updated docking text for Vertex Station

 Ships
-Astral (TW) port/starboard medium energy weapon firing arcs increased from 200 to 220 degrees to lower occurrence of broadsiding

 Weapons
-Brightburn CIWS (normal/ER built-in) updated to a rotary cannon that fires all pulses out of the same location rather than be spread out over three barrels, improving missile intercept chances
-Morningstar/Lightbringer CIWS get a new firing sound, Brightburn CIWS gets its own unique sound
changelog.1.3.2:
v1.3.2 should be compatible with v1.1+ although not guaranteed

 Emergent Threats
 Misc
-(SIC) Synthesis XO capstone skill Temporal Accelerator will now increase all weapon rate of fire by 10% without increasing flux cost
-(SIC/PAGSM) added icon graphics overwrite in the main mod folder to make Andradanism more awesome, see turbocharge_andradanism_for_pagsm folder readme
-(NEX) Changed Tri-Tachyon Mutilator supership start to include a Revenant instead of a Buffalo (TT)
-Fixed a bug where applying Interdictor Array hullmod to one Paragon in ET would make all Paragons change ship systems
-Fixed a bug with the Political Officer hullmod that caused crashes in cross-mod and codex browsing

 Fighters
-Starquake heavy drone role updated to Support, role description updated to Drone Gunship

 Ships
-Aquilon, Candor, Glycon, Maquech, Odyssey (TT), Stonefish added to high tech blueprint package, and will also show up as historian blueprints
-Flamebreaker (EX) deployment points reduced from 30 to 25
-Iris (EX) destroyer that was accidentally removed from the game is re-added to Experimental Design Blueprint package, markets, and fleet spawns
-Maquech carrier ship system PD Drones replaced with Targeting Sweep, a weaker version of Targeting Feed
-Proteus carrier Rapid Deployment will replenish fighters of 12 OP or less, instead of 10

 Ship Systems
-Targeting Sweep damage increased from 25% to 30%, added text showing this bonus in codex

 Hullmods
-Adaptive Flight Command can now be combined with Converted Shuttles (Attack), Converted Shuttles (Bomber), and Carrier Gunships without additional penalty
-(IX) Unified Targeting Core can now be found on IX and Trinity Worlds markets if both ET and IX are installed, and will be used by certain IX/TW NPC ships
-(SIC) Political Officer hullmod should no longer drop, as it is automatically unlocked upon activating an Andradanism XO

 IX Revival
 Misc
-Antimatter Stabilizer cost increased from 10,000 to 100,000 credits
-Trinity Worlds will use carriers slightly more often
-(NEX) Added Trinity Worlds Conflux (TW) supership start
-Fixed a bug where the Aurora (TW) would not use its undershield in player hands
-Hopefully fixed a bug to make the Aurora (TW) "sensor shadow" wreck found during the Lure Infected Fleet mission encounter not recoverable
-Fixed a rare crossmod bug that causes station encounters to crash when the station fleet does not have a flagship
-(AotD) Fixed a bug with the game crashing on the new AotD industry preview window when examining Marzanna Cartel HQ

 Fighters
-Minor updates to IX fighter sprites
-Starquake (TW) role updated to Support, role description updated to Drone Gunship, Stormwall Salvo range increased from 1100 to 1500
-Ultimatum (IX) Temporal Gunship added to the Equalizer (IX) and Mokosh (IX), enabled via the Carrier Gunships hullmod

 Ships
-Aurora (TW) sprite slightly updated
-Astral (TW) added as a rare spawn for Trinity Worlds fleets, comes with unique hullmods, new weapons layout, and built-in variant of the Apotheosis drone, and can switch ship systems and combat behavior with Carrier Gunships
-Conflux (TW) added, for now can only be obtained through Trinity Worlds supership start in Nexerelin
-Flamebreaker (IX/TW) deployment points reduced from 30 to 25
-Flourish (TW) sprite slightly updated
-Fury (TW) added, comes with its own undershield even though it is still very fragile
-Hetman (A) ship system PD Drones replaced with Targeting Sweep, +30% damage to deployed fighters for a short time
-(PAGSM) Iapetus (TW) updated
-Ionos (TW) purchase cost lowered slightly
-Maquech (TW) ship system PD Drones replaced with Targeting Sweep, +30% damage to deployed fighters for a short time
-Mokosh (IX) carrier added, an Anubis derived carrier with Immanence Engine ship system
-Fleet Point reduction for various IX capital ships (Aquilon 28 to 26, Odyssey 30 to 28, Equalizer/Intrepid/Paragon from 35 to 32), slightly reducing their effectiveness in NPC on NPC fights on the campaign layer
-Undershield modules on ships gain passive venting (100/s for Flourish, 150/s for Fury, 200/s for Aurora), and can vent 15% of this as hard flux, allowing undershields to passively recharge even when not actively venting, preventing undershields from being indefinitely partially used up after a skirmish even when there are no enemies nearby

 Ship System
-Immanence Engine ship system on carriers now also applies its effect to deployed Ultimatum (IX) Temporal Gunships, Immanence Engine cooldown reduced from 20 seconds to 15 seconds, Scarab (IX) version remains at 10 second cooldown

 Weapons
-Charge Transfer Emitter seeker projectile initial launch velocity lowered from 800 to 300 to lower occurrences of overshooting the target, EMP effect will trigger at 1600 su with Converging Seeker Lens hullmod
-Dawnstar/Daythron emitter Neutron Generator extra shield damage per second lowered from 150/100/50 kinetic to 90/60/30 kinetic
-Dawnstar/Daythron emitter Proton Generator effect changed from 60/40/20 armor removed per second to 360/240/120 extra fragmentation damage per second on hitting armor/hull
-Impact Fusion Cannon turn rate increase from 12 to 15, gains a magazine that will increase its DPS from 200 (+100 on impact) to 300 (+150) while ammo lasts
-Morningstar CIWS (Fighter) range increased from 500 to 700, found on Terminus (IX) and Ultimatum (IX) wings
-Muon Autolance description update to remove reference to the streamer variant which no longer exists
-Starfall MLRS/Rocket Pod minimal flux cost removed, descriptions updated
-Thundermark Ion Seeker projectile hitpoints lowered from 200 to 50, EMP effect is now against hull/armor only by default, with shield piercing needing Converging Seeker Lens hullmod
-Vampyr DEM graphics reverted from traveling to instant EMP bolts

 Hullmods
-Activate Starquake Drones updated and renamed to Carrier Gunships, and can now also be used on the Astral (TW), Equalizer (IX), and Mokosh (IX) in addition to the Radiant (TW), will add Ultimatum (IX) Gunships on the IX carriers, and can be combined with the Adaptive Flight Command hullmod, and on non-player ships only, if ET is installed, will also convert not built-in Dedicated Targeting Core/Integrated Targeting Unit to Unified Targeting Core on the carrier
-Converging Seeker Lens added to IX/TW markets and NPC ship variants, improves range (and sometimes performance) of Seeker type energy weapons
-Drone Control Node for Trinity Worlds ships is made known to the player at the start of the game
-Energy Weapon Overcharger (obtained from installing an Antimatter Stabilizer to a ship) bonus changed from 25% energy weapon rate of fire and flux cost and 30% range penalty to 35% energy weapon rate of fire bonus, 25% extra energy weapon flux cost (a ~7.4% flux efficiency bonus when ROF is taken into account), and a 20% range penalty
-Entropy Arrester hullmod renamed to Immanence Engine to match ship system
-Trinity Worlds Retrofit default hullmod on TW ships now also applies previously missing 10% range penalty to missile and archaic composite weapons

Note to translator: the exact changes are included in the github notes
